title: THE DIALECTIC KEY & THE GUN CALLED PRAGMATISM
about: A cowboy chained in a prison of shadows is quizzed by talking handcuffs, answers just well enough to open their latch, turns a logic-bound gun on the projector, and shoots his way out as the part that makes bullets.

beats.text: A round prison carved into stone. Film projectors cast shadows on its walls: smiling families, picnics, obedient people. At the center, a cowboy named Tex is cuffed to a chair.
The Governor speaks through a gramophone horn: Tex may leave if he thinks correctly. His handcuffs ask the questions. A masked guard holds a gun that fires only on valid arguments.
Question one. What is justice?
Justice is… me leavin'.
Incorrect. Penalty: clarification.
Premise required to fire.
Premise: You're pointin' a gun at me. Conclusion: I don't like it.
Invalid form.

beats.ask: you can't argue with a man holding a gun

beats.text: Question three. Define "the Good."
The Good is… what keeps my family breathin'.
Answer too particular. The Good must be universal.
Universal, huh? Universal is: a man who steals folks' lives gets shot.
Threat detected. Penalty: re-education.
Final question. If a part cannot exist without the whole, is it unjust to destroy the whole?
Depends.
Define "depends."
Depends… on whether the whole's worth keepin'.
Acceptable. Initiating release sequence— for review.

beats.ask: well, it depends on the circumstances

beats.text: Under the flickering shadows, Tex has been counting the clicks of the reels. A latch in the cuffs slides open, and he jams it with a spur from his sleeve.
State premises or be corrected.
Premise One: You're in my way. Premise Two: I'm done talkin'. Conclusion: Move.
The gun accepts the argument and fires where Tex points: at the projector. The shadow show dies, and the prison goes dark. Tex shears the chair bolt and draws a revolver.
see: a revolver in a man's hand

beats.text: From the horn, the Governor pleads that shooting the lock is a rejection of discourse.
That's the point.
Error. Error. Please reconsider.
No.

beats.ask: sometimes a man has to take matters into his own hands

beats.text: Tex fights his way to a tunnel into the caves. Behind him the Governor shouts that he cannot destroy the whole without destroying himself.
Governor— I am the part that makes bullets.
